blurb:
This five-day journey explores four iconic national parks in the Canadian Rockies—Banff, Yoho, Jasper, and Kootenay. Discover breathtaking glaciers, alpine lakes, waterfalls, and mountain landscapes shaped over millions of years.
Ride the Banff Sulphur Mountain Gondola for panoramic views, stroll along emerald-colored lakes, and experience the Columbia Icefield aboard the Ice Explorer. Witness the powerful Takakkaw Falls and unwind in the mineral-rich waters of Radium Hot Springs, surrounded by majestic peaks.
A perfect blend of spectacular scenery and relaxing moments.

Highlights:
Explore Banff, Yoho, Jasper, and Kootenay National Parks
Visit Lake Louise, Moraine Lake, Emerald Lake, Bow Lake, and Peyto Lake
Experience the Athabasca Glacier and Glacier Skywalk
Relax at historic Radium Hot Springs
